regret_policy.reference_feasible_selection: exact selected-minus-comparator regret only when the complete registered set is sufficiently resolved; otherwise report a labelled difference from the best observed feasible design
regret_policy.unresolved_reference: numeric exact regret unavailable; classify the selected proposal or comparator as unresolved without treating missing evidence as feasibility

analysis_policy.regret_quantity: worst-case reference hydraulic power in W

statistical_interpretation.future_uncertainty_requirement: approved sampling design and justified unit of independent observation

comparator.definition: best observed reference-feasible design; exact finite-set best and regret only when every potentially competitive design is sufficiently resolved in the declared eight-design by six-condition comparison set
comparator.limitations: Best-known only within the declared finite eight-design, six-condition set and periodic-cell scope; it is not a global optimum.

conclusion.does_not_establish: Customer acceptance, global optimality, full cold-plate behavior, transient/controller performance, scientific qualification, or LIVE readiness.
conclusion.establishes: Only the observed DEVELOPMENT results for the frozen finite set, models, methods, budgets, and evidence class.
conclusion.next_expansion: Run the capped counted-CFD plan after owner compute authorization; expand physical scope only after reviewing finite-set failure modes.
conclusion.observed_outcome: All four registered model/search arms selected the same geometry in this fixed pilot. This is agreement, not evidence of a learned-model design-quality advantage.
pilot_questions: Do selected designs satisfy the registered constraints according to reference CFD?
How do selected designs compare with the finite-set reference comparator?
Do registered search methods reduce model queries or computational cost?
Does the learned model change or improve the decision in this particular study?

control_policy.assumption: An implementable supervisory controller receives a commanded or measured steady-state heat load and commands pump flow proportionally before each settled operating point.
control_policy.name: steady-state-feed-forward-flow-per-heat
required_limits: future owner-approved pump flow, pressure and slew limits

accounting_description.actual_cpu_use_limitation: The CPU flag is an allocation limit, not a measurement of CPU time consumed; actual CPU use requires host or container accounting and is reported only when measured.
accounting_description.configured_ceiling_basis: Allocation ceiling equals executions multiplied by 2 CPUs and 3600 seconds: 96 allocated core-hours initially and 120 allocated core-hours including the retry reserve.
accounting_description.estimate_basis: Planning estimate of 0.4 core-hours per solver execution: 19.2 core-hours for 48 initial executions and 24.0 core-hours at the 60-execution hard cap.
accounting_description.overhead_limitation: Orchestration, container startup, storage, artifact processing and host overhead are outside the per-execution solver CPU allocation and must be reported separately when measured.

statistical_interpretation.future_uncertainty_requirement: An approved sampling design and a justified unit of independent observation.
statistical_interpretation.reason: The four arms share one decision problem and may reuse the same design-condition evidence; arm and condition uses are not independent samples.
